ranking_note: Authored from the description at base commit ef4145fa41, frozen before any rewrite; protocol per /playbooks:skill-authoring ## Measurement. Sibling machine-health:setup is in this plugin but user-invoked only (disable-model-invocation true), so it is not a model-invocation competitor, and setup-only phrasings (approve a remediation, schedule the monthly checkup, paste decision-page picks) are left out of both polarities. A request to check a Mac or a Linux box is a positive: the skill owns that answer (report UNKNOWN and stop). Near-misses sit beside installed skills that read machine or Claude Code state (harness-ops:audit-performance, harness-ops:machine-profile, harness-ops:audit-install-state, disk-hygiene:clean, disk-hygiene:audit, repo-hygiene:clean) and beside unrelated health vocabulary (service health endpoints, Kubernetes probes, a cross-machine dashboard, which the skill puts out of scope, a bare CISA KEV lookup, and writing a script rather than running the audit). Positives paraphrase the description rather than repeat its quoted phrases.

queries.request: My Windows 11 desktop has felt off lately. Look over its free disk space, pending updates and Defender status and tell me what needs attention.
Give this PC a once-over: anything risky, low on space or out of date that I should know about?
Do the weekly checkup on my laptop as a dry run, without fixing anything.
Is any app installed on my Windows workstation on the CISA known exploited vulnerabilities list?
How is my MacBook doing? Check its updates, firewall and free disk.
Check my computer's overall security posture and storage, and give me a dated write-up I can keep.
Last month's checkup said C: was filling up. Run it again and tell me whether things got worse.
Inspect this Ubuntu box for problems: updates, disk and security settings.
First time trying this: do an initial health pass of this Windows machine and record a baseline to compare against later.
Before I travel, make sure my work laptop has no stopped services, stale antivirus signatures or nearly full drives.
Claude Code lags every time I type in this session. Figure out why it's so slow.
Find orphaned temp files and stale lock files under ~/projects that I can delete to free space.
Our API's /health endpoint returns 503 right after each deploy. Help me debug the readiness check in Express.
Clear the build caches and prune the stale branches in this repository.
Record which identity domains and git identities this host has configured, and show what changed since the stored profile.
Build a Grafana dashboard showing CPU and disk usage across our 40 office workstations.
Is CVE-2024-3400 in the CISA KEV catalog, and what remediation due date does it carry for federal agencies?
Write a Kubernetes liveness probe for this pod that hits /healthz every 10 seconds.
What is taking up space in my ~/.claude folder, and does Claude Code clean up after itself?
Write a PowerShell function that lists Windows services set to start automatically but currently stopped, for our team's toolbox module.
